description: State Planning Policy 5.1 Land Use Planning in the Vicinity of Perth Airport (DPLH-046) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Planning, Lands and Heritage. The State Planning Policy 5. 1: Land Use Planning in the Vicinity of Perth Airport (SPP 5. 1) applies to land in the vicinity of Perth Airport which is, or may in the future, be affected by aircraft noise.
